text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I've replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread with that number.

It comes from #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. Tobias raised it there on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the barcode scan of the bill of lading (BOL). He confirmed that same day that it was Tansleigh Packaging and not Tansley Parcel.

My reply also says not to mix it up with #8841. That's a different ticket Tobias mentioned in #central-random yesterday, for West yard Door 2 double-booking on his dealer account.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
The ticket is PD-4821. I've replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread with that number.

It comes from #central-team, a channel Tobias is in. Hollis posted it there on 9 Jun 2026 as the ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply. The open issue at the time was that the import file labels doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That has to be sorted before anyone reimports, to avoid duplicates. I put that in my reply too.
